summary_markdown:
The conversation covered technical infrastructure updates, specifically related to a planned move or upgrade of the ClickHouse environment. Initial messages included system diagnostics (disk usage and file size checks) for the current setup.

Later discussions focused on data backup procedures: backups were configured for that night, with plans to add two more machines and connect them to the backups the following morning. A discussion about a new feature in version 21.12 was noted, allowing custom null representation support for TSV/CSV input formats (e.g., changing how 'null' is displayed from '\N' to 'N/A').

While updates were performed, the environment remained on version 21.11.6.7. Finally, questions arose regarding the location of configuration files in Git for the new ClickHouse setup and how to reference these configurations within DDL statements.
decisions: Backups are configured to run that night.
Two additional machines will be added and connected to backups tomorrow morning.
action_items: Locate the configuration file for the new ClickHouse setup in Git (server-[redacted]allunite_dictionaries.xml).
Determine how to reference the new ClickHouse configurations within DDL tables.
